notes.modes: Ohio reports a contest's votes as one Total per county, with the absentee split published on the COUNTY rather than the contest. To separate a contest's election-day votes from its early ones, each county's totals are banked once while Ohio's election-day precinct count still reads zero - at which point the board IS the early vote. Everything after that is exact subtraction, so the election-day figure that gets scaled by precincts never contains early ballots.
notes.outstanding: Outstanding UOCAVA absentees and provisionals are Ohio's own figures, not derived here.
notes.election_day: Ballots still to come on election day are not estimated; only precincts not yet reporting are shown.
notes.test: feed_status and is_test_data come from the feed. Ohio runs mock elections before election day; a board must not show mock votes as real, so this flag travels with the data.
